# Accessibility

We aim to make Simple3D4J examples and documentation accessible to students and developers.

- Use descriptive headings, meaningful links, and readable text.
- Describe visual diagrams and explain the geometry in accompanying text.
- Never use color alone to distinguish X, Y, and Z axes; label them.
- Provide console-based learning examples alongside graphical Swing examples.
- Explain keyboard alternatives to mouse-driven controls when available.
- Keep commands and example output selectable as text.

Report barriers using the Documentation Improvement issue template. Accessibility is an ongoing effort, not a claim of certification.
